audience: Watchstanders and shipboard leaders evaluating fictional tasking locally; no operational use.
primaryTask: Paste or load synthetic OPTASK text, extract Frequency Plan, Crypto Change-over Window and Flight Quarters, review source evidence and mapping, then inspect and export a UTC daily schedule.
successOutcome: A clearly reviewed synthetic revision yields the Synchronized 24-hour Visual Schedule and matching reviewed-schedule.csv and extraction-review.json with full interval provenance.

screens.name: Message and extraction
screens.purpose: Persistent synthetic-only notice; exact raw message, Load synthetic sample, Parse message, immutable revision history and draft state. Evidence inspector exposes each source field without raw JSON dominating the task.

screens.name: Review extraction
screens.purpose: Named category mapping, extracted field table, source evidence, issues, exclusion reason and confirmation checkboxes. All issues require correction/reparse or explicit reasoned exclusion.

screens.name: Daily schedule
screens.purpose: UTC date control, common 00:00–24:00 hourly axis and three category tracks, overlap labels and equivalent textual event list, full interval details and local exports.

screens.name: Synthetic comparison and session
screens.purpose: Secondary finite answer-key comparison with denominators and pending human review; reset confirmation and local storage notices.

states.empty: No extraction yet. Offer Load synthetic sample and explain the pipe grammar. Empty parse shows Enter a synthetic OPTASK message. A reviewed zero-event revision explicitly says No events for this day.
states.loading: Parsing, review, benchmark and exports are local and normally immediate. Announce Parsing synthetic message or Preparing download and prevent duplicate submission until completion; clear working state on failure.
states.error: Show line-specific errors and preserve source. Missing timezone is unknown, never inferred. Disable export with visible reason while stale, unreviewed or unresolved. Storage failure announces Session only: local storage unavailable. Download failure retains reviewed data and offers retry.
states.success: Show exact reviewed revision and selected UTC day, category-specific details, daily clipped minutes, cross-day indicators and overlap. Confirm downloads as local synthetic exports; no operational approval implied.

persistence: Persist exact draft, immutable revisions, current review and selected UTC day in versioned localStorage after each change. Reload restores them. Catch unavailable or corrupt storage, warn and continue session-only without claiming persistence. Confirmed reset clears this app’s key and active state; never clear unrelated storage. Exports are user controlled.
recovery: Source edits mark committed results stale and block export/review. Parse creates a new unreviewed immutable revision; Discard changes restores committed source deliberately. Exclude requires a nonempty reason. Reparse rather than editing original evidence. Reset requires visible confirm/cancel controls. Errors preserve work; only explicit confirmed reset clears it.
keyboard: Use labeled native textarea, date input, checkboxes and buttons; logical source→review→day→export Tab order and visible focus. Enter/Space activate buttons; no keyboard trap. Evidence buttons move focus to a labeled inspector. Reset dialog returns focus to Reset on cancel. Announce status with aria-live, associate errors with controls, and provide a textual schedule. Stack panels and horizontally scroll the hourly timeline within its own region at narrow widths.
